_comment: A small pool of generic, non-story video clips for the junk .mp4/.mov files scattered through the machine (Downloads, Pictures phone backup, etc.) that carry no story significance. Fetched from Pixabay by `npm run fetch:assets` (and on first run, see web/lib/fetchAssets.ts) into generated/filler-video/<id>.mp4. A junk video file picks one clip deterministically from a hash of its own path, the same way lib/synth.ts picks a filler photo scene - nothing here chooses a clip for a particular file on purpose. Until a clip is fetched (no PIXABAY_API_KEY_VIDEOS set), the file falls back to the old silent placeholder.
